title: Bitcoin: Exchange Net Flow Pulse (proxy)
disclaimer: Not CryptoQuant Inter-exchange Flow Pulse. Aggregate CEX netflow/reserve proxy only; no spot→derivatives desk split. Pulse line = CoinMetrics SplyExNtv (BTC held on exchanges / exchange supply). dailyNetBtc = FlowInExNtv − FlowOutExNtv (diagnostic only).
signalRule: bull iff flowBtc >= flowMa90; bear otherwise (including while flowMa90 is null until 90 observations). flowBtc is exchange reserve LEVEL (SplyExNtv), not daily net. Note: rising exchange reserves are often read as sell-side pressure — this rule mirrors IFP-style above-MA shading for UI parity, not a CQ-certified regime definition.
